eyebrow: Sums: expectation always adds, variance only if independent

steps.label: E[X+Y] = E[X]+E[Y]
steps.sub: Always true -- two dice sum to an expected 7

steps.label: Var(X+Y) = Var(X)+Var(Y)
steps.sub: Only if X and Y are independent

eyebrow: A decision: is the raffle ticket worth it?
code:
# $5 ticket, 1-in-30 chance of a $100 prize
E = 100 * (1/30) - 5
print(E)   # -1.67 per ticket
# 1M simulated tickets averaged -1.6752
caption: On average you lose money -- exactly why the business running the raffle profits.
